entities.name: House Fenzala
entities.description: Abzan house that adopted and raised Hamza.

events.summary: In the original timeline Hamza joins the Arashin city guard and becomes its most decorated captain.
events.quote: becoming the most decorated guard captain in the history of Arashin

events.summary: After the New Phyrexian Invasion Hamza commands the Abzan rebellions and is appointed to Yathan leadership after Dromoka's defeat.
events.quote: quickly appointed to a leadership role in the Yathan after the Dromoka's defeat

events.summary: Hamza refuses to leave the Yathan to join the Council of Houses.
events.quote: Hamza refused to leave the Yathan to join the Council of Houses

relations.quote: Hamza was a krumar again, adopted and raised by House Fenzala.
it was his leadership that made him a Yathan prodigy
